I know I have 30 days from delivery to request a return, and I am well within that window, but the system is not letting me proceed with the exchange. This is urgent because I cannot operate my business with defective stock. Please tell me exactly what steps I need to take to finalize this return immediately so I can resolve this inventory issue before it impacts my reputation. I need a clear path forward right now.
